the formation of a small number of EGFP dimers at low occupancy rate on single cells.

the mechanism of the activation of a signaling receptor by the formation of a dimeric signaling complex at the surface of a living cell, which is important for understanding the activation of signaling receptors in general.

the formation of a small number of dimeric binding site of EGFR on a single cell surface is a prerequisite to activate the signaling dimer of EGF/ EGFR complexes.

the formation of a single signaling dimer is not a random event but a highly organized process.

the EGFR signaling system is designed to maximize the efficiency of signal transduction at low occupancy rate.

the EGFR dimeric binding site is a key element in the activation of the EGF/EGF receptor signaling pathway.
